prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
engine_stated_criteria: best option for your specific situation
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim, but the strongest candidates in the search results are firms that specifically advertise **Chicago car accident** and **personal injury** experience, including **Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard**, **Horwitz Law Group**, **Malman Law**, **Disparti Law Group**, and **Briskman & Briskman**.[1][2][5][6][7][9][11]

If you want the most defensible way to choose, look for a lawyer who has handled **cases similar to yours** and who has a strong local track record; one Chicago law firm’s own guidance says to prioritize that exact match of experience.[8] Super Lawyers and Justia also list many top-rated Chicago personal injury/car accident attorneys, which is useful as a starting shortlist, but those directories do not by themselves prove who is “best” for your specific case.[3][4][14]

A practical short list from the results would be:
- **Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.** — prominent Chicago personal injury firm.[1]
- **Horwitz Law Group** — Chicago office and car/truck accident practice.[2][6]
- **Malman Law** — Chicago office and a large reported recovery history.[5]
- **Disparti Law Group** — Chicago car accident page and local office.[7]
- **Briskman & Briskman** — dedicated Chicago car accident practice.[9][11]

For a car accident claim, the most important screening questions are:
- Have you handled **car accident claims** like mine?
- Who will actually work on my case?
- What is your fee structure and consultation policy?
- How quickly can you act, given Illinois deadlines?

Under Illinois law, many personal injury claims must be filed within **two years** of the injury, so timing matters.[1][11]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best option for your specific situation**—for example, if your case involves serious injury, a rideshare crash, uninsured motorist coverage, or a disputed liability issue.
